briefdescription.para: This API sets the elapse interval for the timer instance.
Sets the tick interval from a frequency in Hz.

detaileddescription.para: XTimer_SetInterval() uses whole milliseconds and cannot represent rates that are not exact divisors of 1000. The requested rate is preserved in Hz when the selected timer implements the Hz path.
Sets the tick interval from a frequency in Hz.

simplesect.para: If the selected tick timer does not implement XTimer_TickIntervalHz, this API uses Delay = 1000 / FreqHz with integer truncation, so the programmed rate matches FreqHz only when 1000 is an exact multiple of FreqHz.
